On the asymptotic expansions of
the Kashaev invariant of the knots with 6 crossings
Tomotada Ohtsuki
and
Yoshiyuki Yokota
Abstract
We give presentations of the asymptotic expansions of the Kashaev invariant of the knots with
6 crossings.
In particular, we show the volume conjecture for these knots, which states that the
leading terms of the expansions present the hyperbolic volume and the Chern-Simons invariant of
the complements of the knots. As higher coeﬃcients of the expansions, we obtain a new series of
invariants of these knots.
A non-trivial part of the proof is to apply the saddle poin

The knots with 6 crossings are the 61, 62 and 63 knots, and all of them are hyperbolic.
